title: Let desire drive destiny Set fire and knives to Those Flee A reality Me rooted In thee #smallpoems
summary: Let desire drive destiny Set fire and knives to Those Flee A reality Me rooted In thee #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Let desire
drive destiny
Set fire and
knives to
Those
Flee
A reality
Me rooted
In thee
#smallpoems
